integrity: The source package includes an exhaustive deterministic Python 3 census, full edge-coefficient certificate, and separate finite-field skew-rank checks. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The collision and uniqueness threshold are for connected tree graphical groups and odd finite fields, for irreducible character-degree multiplicity distributions only. A published all-tree formula supplies the rank-to-character conversion and is not claimed as novel. The two associated Lie algebras are nonisomorphic in odd characteristic, and group nonisomorphism is asserted for odd prime fields; a stronger assertion for nonprime odd fields and any full character table equality is not needed. An independent audit was not performed; an unlocated matching-profile collision table remains a residual originality risk.
title: A sharp ten-vertex character-spectrum collision for tree graphical groups
